description:
Delete `IssueApi::update_issue_state`, which moves an issue to a terminal state without promoting dependents and has no production caller.

## Background

`IssueApi::update_issue_state` (`crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs`) is reached only from tests. It reaches `Done` and `Rejected` with no promotion, so it can leave a state `jit validate` refuses.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `update_issue_state` no longer exists, and its test callers reach the state they need through a production path or a shared fixture.
- [hard] REQ-02: Net production lines are negative.
title: Delete the test-only update_issue_state
